q: In February 2026 which superstar bought a 25 percent stake in Segunda side Almería?
note: es wiki UD Almería owner CR7 Investments 25%; en wiki UD Almería; DN.pt, The Objective and Fox Sports MX, 26 February 2026: Ronaldo bought 25%. Two sources confirm.

q: Which Argentine superstar agreed in September 2026 to buy Eldense, a Segunda club from 2023 to 2025?
sub: The deal needed approval from Spain's sports council.
note: Not completed. en wiki CD Eldense says the deal, confirmed 9 September 2026, is subject to due diligence and CSD authorisation; press of 1 October 2026 still lists CSD approval pending. Only an unsourced es wiki line says it was completed. Also Eldense are back in the Segunda from 2026, so "2023 to 2025" misleads.

q: Álvaro Arbeloa's first game as Real Madrid head coach, in January 2026, ended in a 3-2 Copa defeat at which Segunda club?
note: en wiki Álvaro Arbeloa and 2025-26 Copa del Rey: debut 14 January 2026, lost 3-2 at Albacete; AP via ABC News and beIN Sports confirm.

q: Almería changed coach four times under new owner Turki Al-Sheikh in 2019-20. Who replaced Guti in June 2020, only to be replaced himself in July?
sub: José Gomes took over for the play-offs.
note: en wiki UD Almería and 2019-20 Segunda managerial table: Turki Al-Sheikh owner from 2 August 2019; changes Óscar Fernández, Pedro Emanuel, Guti, Mário Silva 26 June, José Gomes 27 July 2020.

q: UCAM Murcia reached the Segunda in 2016 by beating which reserve side 4-3 on aggregate in the play-offs?
note: en wiki UCAM Murcia CF: promoted 2016 after beating Castilla 4-3 on aggregate in play-offs.

q: Huesca's first ever promotion play-off campaign, in 2017, ended in the semi-finals against which club?
note: en wiki SD Huesca: first play-offs after 2016-17, eliminated in semi-finals by Getafe.

q: Ponferradina returned to the Segunda in June 2019 by beating which Alicante club in the play-offs?
note: en wiki SD Ponferradina: 29 June 2019 beat Hércules in two-legged play-off to return to Segunda.

q: Sevilla Atlético won 6-2 at home in April 2017, one of the highest-scoring Segunda games that season. Who did they beat?
note: en wiki 2016-17 Segunda infobox: highest scoring includes Sevilla Atlético 6-2 Valladolid, 16 April 2017.
